content.title: Compass, Anywhere Merger Is Set to Close Friday. Here Comes a Real Estate Brokerage Behemoth.
content.summary: Two of the nation’s largest real estate brokerages are one step closer to combining, creating a behemoth nearly three times as large as their closest competitor.  On Wednesday afternoon,  Compass  and  Anywhere Real Estate  said  stockholders at both companies “voted overwhelmingly” to approve the merger during special meetings earlier in the day.  Compass shares closed 9.3% higher on Wednesday, marking its highest close since late 2021, according to Dow Jones Market Data.
